name: Sub-GHz Signal Capture & Replay
description: Sub-GHz signals (300–900MHz) are used by garage door openers, gate controllers, wireless key fobs, wireless alarm sensors, and remote access systems. The Flipper Zero can receive, record, and replay these signals, potentially opening gates, barriers, and doors using fixed-code systems. Rolling code systems require more sophisticated attacks. Sub-GHz reconnaissance during the perimeter survey phase often reveals entry vectors not discoverable by other means.

blue.det: Replay of static-code signal triggers unintended door or gate open; RF monitoring detects capture devices near entry points.
blue.cm: Rolling-code systems mandatory for all external gates; encrypted sub-GHz protocols where available; RF monitoring near sensitive entry points.
